name: model-finder
description: Pick the right AI model with evidence: compare Claude, Gemini, OpenAI, cloud and local models; run your own examples to measure quality, latency and cost; generate cheapest-first routing; and size local models including KV cache.

defaultPrompt: Which model should I use for this task? Compare providers and explain the cost and quality tradeoffs.
Test whether a cheaper model passes on my examples before I switch.
Will this open-weight model fit on my GPU at 32k context?
interface.longDescription: Compare suitable AI models across Anthropic Claude, Google Gemini, OpenAI, cloud platforms, and open-weight or local models using current official sources. Run the same examples against shortlisted models with a standard-library Python script to measure pass rate, latency, and billed cost using your own API keys from environment variables. Generate a cheapest-first routing setup (standalone router with quality guards plus a LiteLLM config), and estimate local memory for weights and KV cache. Advisory only: nothing is deployed, no active model is changed, and no data is sent anywhere except to the providers you configure and approve.

publication.release_notes: 1.2.0: personal-data and secrets guard (blocks Aadhaar, PAN, cards, email, UPI, mobile numbers and API keys before sending by default), router personal-data policy, and a DPDP Act data-protection record. 1.1.0 added eval-models, route-models and size-local-model.
